scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "bun --filter control-plane dev" "bun --filter dashboard dev" "cd tunnel-server && go run ./cmd/tunneld"
scripts.build: bun --filter control-plane build & bun --filter dashboard build & (cd tunnel-server && go build -o bin/tunneld ./cmd/tunneld) & wait
scripts.go:check: cd tunnel-server && go vet ./... && go test -race ./...
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run go:check
